indexLead: Free, quick calculators that answer common questions before you buy.

tv.title: TV size calculator: which screen size for my viewing distance?
tv.lead: Enter how far you sit from the TV. We show the screen size range recommended by cinema standards (30° to 40° viewing angle).
tv.note: With 4K or 8K you can choose the larger end of the range. With Full HD, stay at the smaller end.

projector.title: Projector distance calculator
projector.lead: Enter the throw ratio from the projector's specifications and the image size you want. We show how far the projector must be from the screen.
projector.note: Throw ratio = distance ÷ image width. Projectors with zoom have a range, for example 1.2–1.5: check both values.

ppi.title: Screen sharpness calculator (PPI)
ppi.lead: Enter the resolution and the diagonal. We show pixel density, pixel size and the distance from which single pixels are no longer visible.
ppi.note: Based on normal 20/20 vision. A typical desk distance is 50–80 cm.

powerbank.title: Power bank on a plane: Wh calculator
powerbank.lead: Airlines limit power banks in watt-hours (Wh), but the box usually shows mAh. Enter the capacity to see whether you can take it on board.
powerbank.ok: Allowed in hand luggage (up to 100 Wh). Never in checked baggage.
powerbank.approval: 101–160 Wh: only with the airline's approval, usually up to 2 per passenger, hand luggage only.
powerbank.forbidden: Over 160 Wh: not allowed on passenger planes.
powerbank.note: Based on IATA rules used by most airlines; your airline may be stricter. Use 3.7 V unless the label shows another value.
